titles.text: VERDANT-1: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 study of lumiravostat (Ostrevia) 10 mg and 25 mg once daily for 16 weeks in adults with moderate to severe chronic hand eczema
Lumiravostat in moderate to severe chronic hand eczema

organizations.name: Halcyon Ridge Pharmaceuticals (fictional)

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN01
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Aged 18 to 75 years when consent is signed

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN02
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Chronic hand eczema for at least 6 months, inadequately controlled with topical corticosteroids

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN03
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: IGA-CHE 3 (moderate) or 4 (severe) at screening and Day 1

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN04
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants of childbearing potential agree to use highly effective contraception until 4 weeks after the last dose and have a negative pregnancy test

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EX01
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: HBsAg positive, or anti-HBc positive with HBV DNA detectable

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EX02
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Systemic immunosuppressant or phototherapy in the 4 weeks before Day 1
